summary: Independently reviewed the original pin-and-test criterion against the immutable 2026-07-28 MCP authorization target, the retained dated compatibility receipt, current metadata builders, both discovery routes and their positive/negative test definitions. A fresh official-source read confirms that the dated target and its discovery page are retrievable and describe the advertised resource/authorization-server discovery profile. The source pins the target explicitly and tests the selected single configured HTTPS profile; no current universal client compatibility is asserted.
limitations: Only the original pinned specification and local metadata/discovery compatibility criterion is accepted by this source review. The 2026-07-28 target was freshly read, but no external client, browser, provider, installed deployment or universal whole-spec conformance was tested. Historical native/unit receipts keep their original cuts and counts. The old admission document predates the later issuer work; its AISEC-009-planned statement is historical, not current task status. Native prerequisite #206 and exact final-main CI remain required.

criteria.criterion: AISEC-010: Pin the targeted specification and test protected-resource metadata and authorization-server discovery.
criteria.basis: Independent current-source review plus unchanged retained qualification. Final acceptance revision CI is checked separately by the completion gate.

findings: The dated discovery admission document and ARCH-008 retain the exact 2026-07-28 authorization URL rather than treating a moving latest page or SDK package version as the pin.

Current builders advertise the configured literal issuer, MCP resource, authorization_servers, authorization/token endpoints, S256 and issuer-response support; registration endpoint presence follows open/disabled policy.
The retained 20 direct builder/route discovery cases are nested in their historical composed qualification; current route/profile tests also retain invalid-configuration and MCP-disabled denials.

Official dated discovery text supports resource metadata with authorization_servers and server metadata discovery. This is a bounded server profile; client endpoint probing, CIMD and whole-spec certification remain outside this criterion.

retained_evidence.status: Historical supporting evidence only; no CI result claimed for the eventual new acceptance revision.

provenance_limit: GitHub authenticates the later delegated posting principal only. This actual Codex review task and retained report are process provenance, not an independently authenticated GitHub reviewer.

official_specification_recheck.result: Both dated official pages retrieved successfully; source review confined to pinned authorization and discovery server profile, not universal compatibility.
